item.title: EOPF Explorer: Sentinel Pipelines for ESA
item.description: Cloud-native ingestion and Sentinel-1 radiometric terrain correction pipelines that turn Sentinel archives into analysis-ready Zarr, built for ESA’s EOPF Explorer.

item.title: When Zarr Stopped Being a File Format: Notes from my first weeks at Development Seed!
item.description: Why understanding Zarr as an API rather than a file format changed my way of thinking about cloud-native geospatial pipelines

item.title: Joining Development Seed to Build Earth Observation Infrastructure
item.description: Excited to announce I’m joining Development Seed as a Cloud Engineer to work on geospatial infrastructure for ESA and ECMWF. From oceanographic fieldwork to satellite data engineering, my journey with Earth observations continues!
